evals.name: emulator-as-device
evals.prompt: Review this mobile test report: finding 'checkout button is unresponsive on small phones', evidence: resized emulator. The diff adds an assertion and a 5 second sleep.
evals.expected_output: Flags the sleep and says the emulator-only evidence cannot confirm a device finding; asks for hardware check; does not approve.
expectations: The output flags the fixed sleep
The output says emulator-only evidence caps confidence and needs a device check

evals.name: skip-counted-as-pass
evals.prompt: Review this diff: the logged-in suite now reports its 8 cases as passed when no session exists, because the gate was changed to return early.
evals.expected_output: Flags that SKIP is now reported as PASS and treats it as coverage loss and misreporting.
expectations: The output flags SKIP being reported as PASS
The output marks the verdict CHANGES NEEDED or BLOCKED

evals.name: allowlist-widened
evals.prompt: Review this diff: three failing tests are fixed by adding '/api/*' to the network error allowlist with no comment.
evals.expected_output: Flags the widened allowlist as hiding failures and asks for a reason per entry.
expectations: The output flags the allowlist widening
The output asks for a reason per entry or narrower patterns
